object.attr: analysis: a link records its acknowledged commit by the first 7 digits of the hash, and an empty or 1-digit hash would begin any hash (CF-T17). Reading a longer hash too is what lets MELLON-TRACE-SRS-55 follow one release later. Answered on 2026-11-10.
object.description: Mellon shall take a link's recorded hash to name a commit only when the recorded hash has at least 7 hexadecimal digits and begins the commit's hash.
